name: ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE

achievements.name: Yellow Turban Rebellion
achievements.detail: Win a battle in a scenario that opens during the Yellow Turban Rebellion.

achievements.name: Against Dong Zhuo
achievements.detail: Win a battle in the scenario where the lords gather to oppose Dong Zhuo.

achievements.name: Battle of Guandu
achievements.detail: Win the struggle in a scenario set around the Battle of Guandu.

achievements.name: Battle of Red Cliffs
achievements.detail: Win the struggle in a scenario set around the Battle of Red Cliffs.

achievements.name: Enter Service
achievements.detail: Offer your service in a lord's city and join that force as an officer.

achievements.name: Free Officer
achievements.detail: Complete a Tale while you travel as a free officer serving no force.

achievements.name: Sworn Siblings
achievements.detail: Build trust with another officer until the two of you become sworn siblings.

achievements.name: A Spouse
achievements.detail: Build trust with another officer until the two of you marry.

achievements.name: Duel Won
achievements.detail: Win a one-on-one duel against another officer.

achievements.name: Debate Won
achievements.detail: Win a one-on-one debate against another officer.

achievements.name: City Governor
achievements.detail: While governing a city, finish a mission that develops it.

achievements.name: Officer Recruited
achievements.detail: Invite an officer from outside your force to come serve with you.

achievements.name: Your Own Force
achievements.detail: Rise from a free officer, gather a following, and claim a city as ruler of your own force.

achievements.name: Unify the Land
achievements.detail: Eliminate every rival force until your side has unified the nation.
